name: BRAND TEXT
description: "SHKOREA is the industry leader of eco-friendly and high efficiency heating system and is committed to manufacturing high efficiency heating films and heating cables. As the oil price is continuously rising and global warming is getting worse, the demand for eco-friendly and high efficient heating system has risen higher than ever. Our Heating film, Hot Film, is the key to heating spaces with the lowest possible pollution and the highest possible energy efficiency. SH Korea has one of the largest production facilities in the world with dedicated technicians and engineers.Our dedicated researchers are always seeking ways to make our products better and make heating more environmentally friendly and effective. Our innovative spirit is also seeking ways to install our system easier and safer. Our heating system, Hot Film, is relatively new system to western world. As Korean cultural wave is spreading throughout the glove, we will generate another wave of traditional Korean Heating – Heating up floor and air with radiant heat. We will lead the Korean wave in construction supply market."
